_comment: Edition-specific facts the pipeline needs but must not hardcode. Read by ingest.py, which passes them into chunk_blocks(). A new system adds a sibling directory with its own copy; a new *edition* of the same book needs page_offset and footer_format re-verified before ingesting, per docs/rules-extraction-findings.md.
_drop_pages_comment: PHYSICAL, 0-based page indices -- not printed page numbers. 4, 41, 42 are the character-creation spread (41 and 42 are byte-identical duplicates of 4), excluded because the Warden structurally cannot reach them: rules_lookup is wired only into the play-loop tool array and character creation makes no Anthropic calls at all. 3 is the character-profile sheet, excluded on measured evidence rather than reachability: it held 10 of 147 top-3 slots and outranked the correct page for two answerable combat queries. See docs/decisions.md 'Character-creation content is excluded from the rules index' and docs/rules-extraction-findings.md S2, S17, S18.
